claim.label: architecture note
claim.sentence: Waymo Jaguar I-Pace robotaxi architecture note Lidar, radar and camera are all carried, in-house designed, and treated as redundant rather than complementary; the cost argument is deferred in favour of a sensor set that fails independently.
